names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name link 9257 as the day page prints it, «Александр (Заозерский), протоиерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмчч. Василия , Александра и Христофора пресвитеров, прмч. Макария и мч. Сергия (1922).» — and the surname is read off the name page behind it. The parenthesis is the calendar's own. `fk.mjs` on «Александр Заозерский» returned NONE before the write.

birth.note: The shared life page, life4778: «Протоиерей Александр Заозерский, настоятель храма святой Параскевы-Пятницы в Охотном ряду, родился 20 июля 1879 года в Москве в семье священника».

death.note: The year the day line closes the five with, «(1922)», and the shared life page's own: «Расстреляны они были в начале июня 1922 года» — they were shot at the beginning of June 1922. The page gives no day, and no day is recorded here.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Василия , Александра и Христофора пресвитеров, прмч. Макария и мч. Сергия (1922).»

attestations.note: One of the five the line names, each with a name page of his own and all five sharing one life page, life4778, which is the Moscow trial over the confiscation of church valuables in 1922. `office` is `Archpriest`, which both the name page and the life page give him; the day line's «пресвитеров» covers the first three of the five at once and is the looser word. The page lists «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 13 мая»; **the 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia**, a company's feast and not his own day, so it is a note here and the feast is the day page that printed him (BRIEF.md §8). Checked before writing: `grep -l Заозерск saints/*/saint.json` returns nothing at all, and `fk.mjs` on «Александр Заозерский» returned NONE. The day page prints hymns for three of the saints it heads and nothing under the five. **`related` carries the other four of the line**, which is the tie the source itself makes. azbyka.ru was not read.
